item.title: Walt Disney Company wins 22 awards at Children's & Family Emmys in New York City
item.description: The Walt Disney Company won 22 awards across its content brands and studios, including Disney+, which took home 21 of those awards.

item.title: Timber Grove resident makes FAQ sign about sidewalk damaged in water leak repair
item.description: Six months of 311 requests led one resident to post a tongue-in-cheek Q&A about a drawn-out sidewalk repair.

item.title: Small chance for a big storm Wednesday, higher rain chances for Houston this weekend
item.description: Rain chances will stay low through Friday, then widespread rain is possible this weekend, especially Saturday.

item.title: Bonobo lunges at guests, cracking glass enclosure at Memphis Zoo, shocking video shows
item.description: Wild video from the Memphis Zoo shows the moment an ape lunged at visitors, smashing a pane of glass in the enclosure.

item.title: WATCH: National Geographic's 'Secrets of the Bees' trailer from executive producer James Cameron
item.description: From executive producer James Cameron, National Geographic's "Secrets of the Bees" explores the world of bees with never-before-filmed moments.

item.title: Joan Lunden reflects on groundbreaking career, new book with former GMA colleague Bill Ritter
item.description: She sat down with our own Bill Ritter, her longtime co-worker, to talk all about it, including her advice for young people starting their careers in the news business and taking a trip down memory lane.

item.title: Pentagon IDs 4 American troops killed in Kuwait
item.description: The Pentagon on Tuesday identified four of the six American troops killed in the opening hours of the war with Iran.

item.title: 2 suspected car burglars arrested after brief chase in Greenway Plaza, HPD says
item.description: A brief police chase in Greenway Plaza ended Tuesday afternoon with two suspected car burglars crashing their vehicle and being taken into custody.

item.title: Suspicious driver with ammo arrested near Ken Paxton's campaign watch party, Dallas PD says
item.description: The Dallas Police Department said it arrested a suspicious driver and found ammo in his car near Ken Paxton's campaign watch party.

item.title: Mother arrested again after 2-year-old son found wandering alone in diaper, court records show
item.description: A north Harris County woman has been charged with abandoning her children for the second time in the last year, according to court records.
